aiDataSharing.label: AI data sharing
aiDataSharing.description: Sends what you type and your speech turned into text to Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI to organize it into to-dos. If your device can't recognize speech on its own, Apple or Google speech recognition may turn your voice into text. Audio files are never sent to Aido servers.
aiDataSharing.descriptionGoogleOnly: Sends what you type to Google Gemini to organize it into to-dos
aiDataSharing.withdrawDescription: You won't be able to use AI to organize to-dos, reports, or suggestions. Existing to-dos stay.
aiDataSharing.declinedStatus: Turned off. Turn it on to use AI features again.
aiDataSharing.undecidedStatus: Not chosen yet. We'll ask the first time you use an AI feature.

voiceStorage.description: Audio files are never sent to Aido servers. Voice notes and their audio are removed automatically after 30 days.
voiceStorage.removeDescription: The text and summary stay. Only playback goes away. This can't be undone.
